api/overview.title: API Overview
api/overview.description: Domitara exposes a REST API at /api/v1. All request and response bodies are JSON.

getting-started/configuration.title: Configuration
getting-started/configuration.description: Domitara is configured entirely via environment variables. Copy .env.example to .env for local development, or set these as environment variables / Docker secrets in production.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Domitara is a self-hosted home inventory and management application — a modern replacement for Homebox.
